name: Qlib Alpha158 A-share stock comparison, fixed before fit
selection_policy: One unchanged LightGBM specification, official Qlib Alpha158; no OOS tuning or early stopping
scope: A-share individual stocks in package historical CSI300 intervals, not ETF rotation or all-market coverage claims

cost_sources.supports: Stamp tax 0.5 permille seller only; transfer fee 0.01 permille both sides; regulatory charges are included in brokerage commission.
Stamp duty halved from 2023-08-28; OOS is 2025 onward.

cost_limitations: Commission 3bp and slippage 2bp are research assumptions, not this user broker contract.
Minimum commission, integer lots, order queues and cash/share corporate-action ledger are not simulated.
Flat fees apply only to this declared 2025-onward OOS; earlier tax regimes are not modelled by the constant rates.
